module: Editor tool utility for "gate" handles that can be moved along the outline of a polygon (ring: list of {x,y} points). A gate is { edge, t, id }: edge index and position t (0..1) on that edge. Provides snapping to the outline, default gates (ends of the long axis), the geometry of a floating handle outside the edge and its drawing via debugDraw.
notes: The ring is implicitly closed: edge i goes from point i to point (i % n) + 1.
The center used (centroid) is the simple average of the vertices, not area-weighted.
gateWorldDir returns 4 values (wx, wy, nx, ny), the normal pointing away from the ring center.

tagGates.desc: Gives a unique id (Engine.generateUUID) to each gate that has none, then returns the list. A gate is otherwise identified only by its position in the list, which changes when a previous gate is removed.

gates.desc: List of gates { edge, t, id? }

returns.desc: The same list, with named gates.

nearestGate.desc: Snaps a world point (px,py) to the nearest gate on the outline.

gateWorldDir.desc: World position of a gate and the outward unit normal of its edge (away from the ring center).

defaultGates.desc: Two default gates at opposite ends of the ring's long axis (entry, exit).

handleGeom.desc: Geometry of a gate's grabbable handle: the bar floats at outDist meters off the edge and extends halfWidth meters on each side.

outDist.desc: Distance of the bar from the edge (m)

liftFn.desc: function(x,y) -> vec3 that places a point on the terrain; z=0 plane by default.

drawHandle.desc: Draws the handle (points from handleGeom): stem from the edge to the bar, bar with end points, central button that pulses on hover.
